hypothesis: Frozen pretrained features may insufficiently adapt to small players and grey central officials. Allow feature adaptation while holding data, seed, resolution and remaining settings fixed.
evidence: P003 validation: player 73 FN/264, referee 12 FN/24 at confidence .25. Central official is not detected.
primary_selection: player AP50:95 on the same 12 validation frames, then player AP50; retain simpler usable model on tie. Referee coverage is incomplete and not a general role-recognition benchmark.
